_about: The correction and learning register (APE-501 section 12.3; CA-22). Each entry records what was wrong, how it was found, why the existing checks missed it, the correction and the test that prevents a recurrence. Entries are appended, never edited.

entries.what_was_wrong: The UP-04b irreducibility test accepted a reducible sextic.
entries.how_detected: The full register rerun of the 19 November audit.
entries.why_checks_missed_it: The test had no known reducible case among its checks.
entries.correction: UP-04b marked REVISED; UP-04b-R1 uses Rabin's irreducibility test (PROVED).

entries.what_was_wrong: The STP runner overwrote the status REVISED with the outcome of a rerun.
entries.how_detected: The audit rerun turned UP-04b into REJECTED.
entries.why_checks_missed_it: The runner set the status from the outcome alone.
entries.correction: An entry marked REVISED keeps REVISED on any rerun; every change is written to status_history.
entries.prevention: The runner rule in tools/stp.py; status_history on every entry.

entries.what_was_wrong: CX-009 failed on legacy runs without fingerprints and on a wrong criterion.
entries.why_checks_missed_it: Fingerprints were not required before CX-009 existed.
entries.correction: CX-009-R1 passes with the exceptions named.

entries.what_was_wrong: CAP-01 demanded a valuation of exactly r where the construction gives at least r.
entries.why_checks_missed_it: The criterion was written before the construction's valuation was worked out.

entries.what_was_wrong: Construct X 2.3.1 capped the 3-adic depth at 30 and misclassified all 1,951 deep states.
entries.prevention: CAP-01 and CAP-01-R1 include deep states.

entries.what_was_wrong: The Lab fell back silently when no base lag was found.
entries.how_detected: The audit of the Lab tabs.
entries.why_checks_missed_it: No output field reported the fallback.
entries.correction: base_lag_status and the periodicity verdict are reported.

entries.what_was_wrong: The training guide said the Williams schedule ran in the Lab, and gave version 2.2.0.
entries.why_checks_missed_it: Statements in the guide were not tied to a check.
entries.correction: Both corrected; williams_schedule added to Construct X.

entries.what_was_wrong: An SNCA report quoted APE-496 by paraphrase.
entries.how_detected: Verifying every [U] quote against its source.
entries.why_checks_missed_it: The quote was typed, not copied.
entries.prevention: Every [U] quote is checked verbatim against the frozen file before filing.

entries.what_was_wrong: APE-486 to APE-499 carried intake times later than the clock (12:00Z and 15:00Z written at 03:46Z).
entries.how_detected: The Navigator compared the clock while filing (L-542 of 19 November).
entries.why_checks_missed_it: No check compared record times with the clock.
entries.correction: Times corrected to the actual intake times.

entries.what_was_wrong: APE-416 to APE-427 carried the prose time '7 November 2026T12:00:00Z' in disclosed_utc and accepted_utc.
entries.correction: Rewritten in the same instant as 2026-11-07T12:00:00Z; the meaning is unchanged.

entries.what_was_wrong: APE-045 to APE-047 record accepted_utc 2026-10-16T06:49:58Z, earlier than their disclosed_utc (08:00 to 08:02Z).
entries.why_checks_missed_it: No check compared the two fields.
entries.correction: Not corrected: which time is wrong cannot be recovered from the record. ESC confirmed the records as they stand (D-11, 19 November 2026); the check reports these three as known.
entries.prevention: tools/timestamp_check.py rule 3 (order), with this entry named as the known exception.

entries.what_was_wrong: The 11 Construct-phase reviews were filed under a new author label, which split ChatGPT's signature counts.
entries.why_checks_missed_it: The label was typed without checking the existing labels.
entries.correction: Normalized to the existing label 'ChatGPT (OpenAI) for ESC'.

entries.what_was_wrong: APE-503 to APE-505 were filed with acceptance times up to 7 minutes later than the clock.
entries.why_checks_missed_it: Nothing was missed: the check introduced by COR-009 caught the error before the record was committed.
entries.correction: Times moved to the actual intake times.
entries.prevention: tools/timestamp_check.py in CI; the Navigator reads the clock before writing an intake time.

entries.what_was_wrong: The Navigator's answer and RC-01 stated that over the reals every difference between two coupled persons grows by at least sqrt(5)/2 per step; a real difference on the contracting eigenvector can shrink, and vanishes at s = -1/phi or phi. The answer also called N's value the 'size' of the difference.
entries.why_checks_missed_it: The test checked the least spectral radius, which is correct, not the wording of the hypothesis, which overstated it.
entries.correction: Companion 233.15 RC2 and 233.12 M1 corrected; RC-01 marked REVISED; RC-01-R2 registered and verified.
entries.prevention: A hypothesis's wording is checked against what its criterion tests before registration.

entries.what_was_wrong: RC-01-R1 required a rational difference to grow beyond 1,000 in 40 steps; at pull 1/2 the bound gives 1.118^40 = 87, so the test failed although the statement holds.
entries.why_checks_missed_it: The threshold was chosen before computing what the bound guarantees.
entries.correction: RC-01-R1 marked REVISED; RC-01-R2 registered with a tenfold threshold derived from the bound, and verified.
entries.prevention: A numerical threshold is derived from the stated bound, never chosen by eye.
